Create a passkey from a password passed through the PBKDF2-SHA256 algorithm configured to use 600,011 iterations and the email as a salt. The supplied password must conform to the following guidelines:
* The password has a minimum length of eight characters.
* The password contains at least three of the following:
  * A lowercase letter (a–z)
  * An uppercase letter (A–Z)
  * A number (0–9)
  * A special character (@ $ ! % *  # ? &)
Note that it is recommended to perform this encryption yourself
